context: Tests whether the agent uses OTTL to filter stale telemetry with time comparisons using UnixNano(Now()), backfills missing log timestamps using the correct two-step pattern, uses int64 enum constants for span status/kind comparisons, uses IsMatch() with regex for pattern-based dropping, and uses nil as the absence keyword throughout.

checklist.name: UnixNano(Now()) for stale drop
checklist.description: Uses `time_unix_nano < UnixNano(Now()) - <offset>` (or equivalent) to drop data older than a defined threshold, using the UnixNano() and Now() functions

checklist.name: Stale drop uses filter processor
checklist.description: Stale data is dropped using the filter processor (not the transform processor)

checklist.name: Timestamp backfill observed_time
checklist.description: Uses `set(log.observed_time, Now()) where log.observed_time_unix_nano == 0` (or functionally equivalent) to backfill missing observed time

checklist.name: Timestamp backfill log.time
checklist.description: Uses `set(log.time, log.observed_time) where log.time_unix_nano == 0` (or functionally equivalent) to backfill missing log time from observed time

checklist.name: Enum constant STATUS_CODE_ERROR
checklist.description: Uses the int64 constant `STATUS_CODE_ERROR` (not an integer literal like `2` or a string) when comparing or setting span status code

checklist.name: IsMatch() for pattern filtering
checklist.description: Uses IsMatch() with a regex pattern to filter out (drop or flag) metrics or spans matching a name pattern

checklist.name: filter processor for metric drops
checklist.description: Metrics dropped by pattern use the filter processor (not transform with a delete operation)

checklist.name: nil for absence checks
checklist.description: All where-clause absence checks use `!= nil` (not `!= null`)

checklist.name: error_mode set explicitly
checklist.description: Every processor that uses OTTL includes an explicit `error_mode:` key

checklist.name: where clause nil guards on attrs
checklist.description: Statements that operate on span or log attributes include `where <attr> != nil` guards before acting on those attributes
